title: `VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D` not works well with `ScrollContainer`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.beta3.official [76dda5c6c]

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7680) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 47.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

In the MRP, only when the `ScrollContainer` occupies full rect with the screen (screen height in this case), the `VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D` behaves well.
If the `ScrollContainer` only occupies a part of the screen (screen height in this case), the `VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D` behaves badly.

Expected: when the `VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D` node is on screen, it's parent (a ColorRect) changes purple); when the `VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D` node exits screen, it's parent changes to white.

PS: In the video, on the left, is a `ScrollContainer` whose height is same with screen's height; on the right, is a `ScrollContainer` whose height is short.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/066e4483-ef72-49a7-a8eb-263c710ff1dc

### Steps to reproduce

Test with MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_visible_on_screen_notifier_2d_2026-01-09_10-10-51.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24512436/test_visible_on_screen_notifier_2d_2026-01-09_10-10-51.zip)
